title: How do you pick an AI platform for professional services firm administration in SMBs?
summary: Learn how to pick an AI platform for professional services firm administration in SMBs with no-code tables, AI agents, OCR, and Chat with Data.
body_markdown:

In **Jestor** , these pieces work together, and the AI App Builder can create a first version from a text description.


## Why do services firms need AI in administration?


Firm teams spend hours on client questions, document typing, and reports.


Generic chat tools do not connect to firm processes, and custom development is expensive.


## What should an AI platform for services firms include?


- No-code tables for firm processes
- AI agents on **WhatsApp** with supervision
- Document reading with **OCR**
- Permissions and security certifications
